description: Shared grid/list pattern for Student-facing card collections with no exact showcase composition — Explore, Learning Paths, My Learning, Certificates all reduce to: an optional filter/search row, then a responsive card collection, then standard empty/loading/error states.
structure: optional filter/search row (SearchField and/or CategoryChip row and/or status-filter chips)
responsive card grid or single-column list per screen's own courseGrid/exception rule
EmptyState if zero results, ErrorState on load failure, skeleton LoadingState while pending

gridExceptions.learningPaths: 2-3 column cap even at Large Desktop
gridExceptions.certificates: 2-3 column cap even at Large Desktop
